chapters: Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xijumai maa'n gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak dhi' gu vaak oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai'; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr cham; jano' ba' cham; gio ba' dhi'ñi.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu u'u gu vaak; gio ba' aagak jix duñia' nɨidhat tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gaagim jix jai' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu vaak oidha' jix gaki maa'n jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu ñi'ook dhuuk gu oidha' gu i'bhɨ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhi' gu oidha' bhaan gu kakkavɨk bhaan tiriik bhaan suudai' u'va bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan bɨx gu oidha' bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vaakax bhaan bɨx tu jiim gu noobh.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo na ja'p ka't gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu aggeo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xijumai gook oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu ñi'ook maa'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bham.
Jano' ba' chɨkka tu' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't buupui dhi' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' jano' cham na ja'p cham tu' vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Na gu' jano' gu Sorobabeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gio gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam bɨx gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'.
Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp ɨlhdham gu Deseado bɨx chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Miia jix toja jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak ka't jix gɨ' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' pai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' maakob jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook oi'ñga' gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jano' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bɨɨx kuichdha' gu takarui' suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' jugi ka't tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gui'p; gio ba' cham.

Ba' jix aa' gu aggeo; gio ba' tu' ñaanbi' kuiñcha gu chuukug jix koi kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu aggeo; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam dhi' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; jano' ba' bɨx ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ dɨr dhi' gu tanoolh jix duñia' va'k jaisaidhat gu jodai bhaan gu jodai vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' va'k bhaai'n dhi' tu'x aajidha' gɨ' kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't mambhɨɨx; gio ba' aajidha' na ba' mambhɨɨx ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gu' cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu i'ii'ñ dɨr dhi' gu tanoolh jix duñia' dɨr gu tanoolh maakob jix bhai'x dɨr gu tanoolh vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu kai' tu' iigɨx tu' gu u'u tu'; gu' dɨr gu tanoolh jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' ka't gookim jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu aggeo maakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Sorobabeel gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa bham; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bhaan atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' bhaan; mi' dhɨr aajim jix duñia' gɨ' kavɨk gu kuchii xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
